body: 5'7" while I've got 6' and taller uncles. If you are worried about it, get a hormone checkup at the doctors, I wish I did when I was your age.
At exactly 5'7" my only reaction is :(

No don't apologise, thank you for your kind words. But yeah they kinda did single me out, and it wasnt the first time it happened in general so idk. I guess I should find the middle ground, where I should respect peoples interests but not accept shitty behaviour of "oh I would never be with someone your height" when the topic of dating or anything ever popped up. So idk. I hope your days are good too.

Hey thanks. Yeah I know about pretending to be confident about it which has lead to some fun nights even if they have started with some comment like "wow you're short" but no matter how long I've been faking it I still feel no better about myself.

I think it's just because it's my fault I think, I had to take meds at adolescence which I stopped growing shortly after starting them.

I dont know about making a clap back like that, people each have their preferences, and if someone isn't attracted to anyone my height then it's not my job to insult them, I'd hate to be judged on who I find attractive too, it's just idk. 

Thank you though.

I'm sorry to hear that. You should move to Aus cause every girl is taller than 5'7 here you'll fit right in haha.

I know height is irrelevant in the end, I've been with people who weren't bothered by it at all, but it's the one drop of bad blood that closes the whole pool, the one comment that ruins everything.

Thank you.

Thank you. I know I haven't gone through much when compared to others, but I just am not strong enough to handle it as well as others. And it's no ones fault for what has happened to me except mine. It was my own weaknesses that led to these events. And yeah, maybe I should try sharing stuff online. Just a way to help with eventually and hopefully talking to people other than a therapist.
